title: 落雨天的野餐
text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}蘿拉和{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗在沙灘上野餐。{girl:face happy}{dog:live wag-tail}忽然……滴。答。{canvas:rain 0.8 18s}{sfx:rain}滴滴答答！下雨了！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[excited]「小狗，快啲！走入太陽傘下面！」 {girl:go under umbrella}{dog:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}他們一起擠在紅白色的大太陽傘下面。{umbrella:pulse}雨點打在傘頂上，噠、噠、噠。{girl:face happy}真舒服！{dog:live play-bow}可是小狗坐不定。{dog:go to girl right}牠一下子衝進雨裏，{dog:face happy}跑了一圈又一圈。然後，牠跑回來，{dog:go under umbrella}全身濕淋淋的，{dog:live shake}就在蘿拉身邊，用力一抖！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「小狗！我而家仲濕過場雨呀！」 [short pause]{canvas:rain stop}後來，雨停了。{umbrella:live spin}太陽傘輕輕轉了一個圈，把最後幾滴水甩掉。{canvas:rainbow 14s}[gasps]看！海灣上空，出現了一道彩虹。{girl:face happy}{dog:face happy}{girl:says}[softly]「濕咗都值得呀。」 {dog:hearts}
